messages:
Maria L.: Heads-up: Acadia Health private/VPC deployment scheduled TOMORROW 2026-04-01 02:00-04:00 UTC (change window). Need deploy owner, smoke lead, rollback owner. No DB migration. Image tag: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:acadia-2026-04-01. Ping @Kevin @Sam for infra details.

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created DPL-3245 · PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/inference/pulls/817 · Pipeline: passed ✅

Sam R.: I can own the deploy. Plan: start rollout at 02:00, cordon & drain nodes in the VPC pool, apply new Deployment image, run smoke checks (health + small generation), then uncordon. Expect ~30m, will keep window 2h for safety. Rollback if >5% error rate or >3s p50 latency regression. I'll be on-call phone + pager.

Kevin T.: Image pushed and OCI manifest verified. Config changes: env REDWOOD_MODE=private, KMS keys already staged. I'll warm KV cache before start. Quick smoke commands: ```bash
# health
curl -sS -f https://acadia-vpc.internal/health
# quick gen
curl -sS -X POST https://acadia-vpc.internal/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"ping","max_tokens":8}'
```
I'll also run `python tools/smoke.py --host https://acadia-vpc.internal --prompt "test" --timeout 5` from bastion.

Anya P.: I'll lead smoke monitoring and logs. Kibana dashboard: dashboards/acadia-private-ops. Plan: run smoke.py after Sam finishes rollout and watch for error traces, tokenization errors, and OOMs. If I see repeated 500s or large latency regressions I'll notify @Sam and escalate to #incidents. I'll also tail the perf metrics and post a summary at +10m, +30m.

Sam R.: Rollback plan: promote previous image tag acadia-2026-03-25, command: `kubectl -n private set image deploy/redwood-inference inference=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:acadia-2026-03-25` then rollout status check. We'll keep the old image available in the registry for quick promote. No DB rollback required.

Maria L.: Great — please add the short smoke checklist to the DPL ticket and confirm slack pager chain. Can SREs also be added to the event? :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "private-deploy-acadia-2026-04-01 02:00-04:00 UTC" · Attendees: Sam R., Kevin T., Anya P., SRE on-call · Ticket DPL-3245 updated with calendar link.

Kevin T.: ack :thumbsup:

Anya P.: I'll post the +10m status in this thread and attach the Kibana snapshots if anything looks off.

Maria L.: Thanks all — will follow up w/ customer PM to confirm no traffic blackouts on their side. If anything changes ping here. :pray:
